items.title: The Chip Shortage Is Back, and Microchip Says AI Customers Are Crowding Everyone Out
items.summary: Microchip beat its own forecast, yet the stock still got hammered. The CEO says AI buyers swept through supplier factories and shoved everyone else aside, and one fix could take six months. Is this a lasting problem or a timing glitch?

items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Added AI And Space Chips As Q2 Hit $1,621.5 Million
items.summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) announced acquisitions of edge AI chip designer Hailo and radiation-hardened specialist Vorago Technologies in 2024. The Hailo purchase adds dedicated processors for accelerated AI at the device level, aimed at compact and power-limited hardware. Vorago Technologies brings components built for harsh environments such as aerospace and defense, including high radiation and extreme temperatures.
